title: Air Fryer Broccoli

steps.x: Cut the broccoli into florets of about 4cm. Wash them, then dry thoroughly with a clean towel. Wet florets steam instead of crisping.
Toss the florets with the oil in a large bowl until evenly coated. Add Seasoning A or Seasoning B, not both, and toss again. Cajun mixes already contain salt, so add no extra.
Preheat the air fryer to 190°C for 3 min.
Spread the florets in a single layer in the basket. Cook at 190°C for 5 min, shake or toss, then cook another 5 min until the edges are charred and the stems are tender.
Tip into a bowl and toss with the lemon juice. Serve straight away.

notes: Don't overcrowd the basket. If you double the batch, cook in two rounds.
With Seasoning B, set aside the child's portion and season it with only salt (0.25 tsp) and oil before adding cajun to the rest.
For softer broccoli, cook 2 min longer. For darker, crispier tips, cook 2 min longer and shake once more.
Eat fresh. Leftovers keep 2 days in the fridge but soften. Reheat in the air fryer at 180°C for 3 min.
